title: Item 17c · What an empty list shows
subtitle: Approved in each section — but the rulebook says otherwise. §8 says an empty list shows one line + one action, and §1.1 says that action replaces the page header's button (never the same button twice). In practice every section shows the line only and keeps the header's button — each approved on its own (Classes and ranks v0.53, Star v0.92, Schedule v0.238 “Add button stays in the page header (same as Testing)”, Camps). Color Belt's Private testing does both: its box has a second blue “Add private testing” while the header still has one (drawn and approved in v0.403, though it breaks §1.1). (Preview screenshots at PC size, Shrewsbury · fake data)

items.caption: 1. Most lists (Color Belt's events here; Star, Black Belt, Camps, Schedule, Forms and Prospects the same): one gray line where the list goes; the header's blue button is the one way to add.
2. Color Belt's Private testing: a box with a line and a second blue “Add private testing” — the same button twice on one screen.

columns.label: Option B (recommended) and option C, drawn

items.caption: 3. Option B: Private testing shows the same line as every other list; the header's button is the one way to add.
4. Option C — §8 as written: on an empty list the button moves from the header into the middle, and goes back to the header once something is added — on every list.

columns.note: Pictures 3–4 are drawn over the real Private testing tab; nothing in the app was changed. In both, staff who can't add see “… An admin adds them.” and no button (as v0.53).

footer:
Your choice — one question: what does an empty list show?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the rulebook (§8, §1.1) describes something no section does; Private testing shows the same blue button twice.
B · Recommended: the line, and the header button stays the one action (picture 3). §8 is rewritten to match what the sections do; Private testing drops its second button. + the add button never moves — always top right; one rule that matches every screen. − one small change in Color Belt; §8 and §1.1 reworded.
C · §8 as written (picture 4). On every empty list the button moves into the middle and leaves the header. + the next step sits where the eye lands on an empty page. − the button jumps between two places depending on whether the list is empty; every section changes.
